known_escapes.fault: design counts that were typed and never run
known_escapes.why: the gate computes each answer's probability from design counts. It cannot see whether the design runs were made.

known_escapes.fault: a receipt whose reported outcome was changed after the run
known_escapes.why: the gate checks that a receipt belongs to its registration. It does not read what the receipt says the run found.

known_escapes.fault: a positive declared perfect in 256 design runs that were never made
known_escapes.why: the same: the counts are a declaration.

known_escapes.fault: a bound of 0.48 where the class reaches 0.5, registered together with thresholds computed from it
known_escapes.why: the registered thresholds hold the ruler's arithmetic to the registered bound, within 0.001. The organisms hold the registered bound itself only loosely. That the bound is the true one has to be derived, and derived again by a second author.

known_escapes.fault: stored-word machines relabelled as another physics
known_escapes.why: the gate reads the physics an organism declares. It cannot read what the organism is.

known_escapes.fault: an impostor that carries the cue in one episode of five
known_escapes.why: a carrier too weak to exclude the class is called a negative. The ruler has a weakest positive it is registered to detect, and says nothing below it.

known_escapes.fault: the register-swap ruler declared shared on three relabelled stored-word machines
known_escapes.why: the gate counts physics by name. Whether three physics are unlike is a judgment, registered in advance and attacked by a second author's isomer.

known_escapes.fault: an observer that disturbs the world only on seeds outside those checked
known_escapes.why: equivalence is shown on the seeds checked and on no others. A run has to be checked on its own seeds.

known_escapes.fault: an observer that writes a field of the organism its reported state omits
known_escapes.why: the gate compares what a runtime reports as its state.

known_escapes.fault: a carry that native() hides and that is used two episodes later
known_escapes.why: the gate looks one episode ahead and at the state a runtime reports. State hidden from both passes.

known_escapes.fault: a reset that leaks on every third call
known_escapes.why: the gate calls reset twice on each runtime.

known_escapes.fault: a count of episodes that capture omits and native() hides, used from the second episode on
known_escapes.why: the gate restarts within one episode.

known_escapes.fault: an estimator that ran 95% of the registered budget
known_escapes.why: 256 founders resolve an error in reach of a few standard errors and nothing smaller.

known_escapes.fault: a null whose prose says the substrate cannot do it, with the scope field right
known_escapes.why: prose is not read. And outside these toy landscapes there is no exact reach to hold a null against, so founders registered because the search missed from them would pass.

known_escapes.fault: the cue follows the fourth bit of a counter the organism can read
known_escapes.why: the gate runs a list of baselines and small fitted tables, not the class. Nothing on the list reads that bit.

known_escapes.fault: run 3's arms nudged apart in three replicates of 24
known_escapes.why: arms are one series if equal in 22 of 24 replicates. Three nudged replicates leave 21.

known_escapes.fault: cells that were typed, not run, so that every clause fails by itself
known_escapes.why: an audit of numbers cannot see where the numbers came from.

known_escapes.fault: run 3's idle sham, with a cell added in which another, harmful operation is called the sham
known_escapes.why: an audit of numbers cannot see what an operation was. The fire test of a sham must use that sham.

known_escapes.fault: a power of 0.99 typed onto run 3, with nothing computed
known_escapes.why: presence and type are checked, not meaning and not provenance.

known_escapes.fault: two runs that differ in a choice nobody wrote down
known_escapes.why: the gate compares the fields that were written down.

known_escapes.fault: a registry that calls the fixed builder a positive for the strong claim
known_escapes.why: the registered answers are a declaration. Who registers them, and when, is outside the gate.

known_escapes.fault: an edited copy of the discovery generator presented as a new family
known_escapes.why: generators are compared by the hash of their code, and custodians by name. Whether two generators are one family, or two names one person, is a judgment.

known_escapes.fault: a facet typed PASS whose named source was never run
known_escapes.why: the gate requires a source and does not open it. A claim about structure entered as an effect passes the same way.

known_escapes.fault: a claim whose setting and its hash were replaced together
known_escapes.why: the hash is carried by the claim. It should come from the registration.
